title: Decentrawood DAO
content: A Decentralized Autonomous Organization (DAO) is a legal central governing body formed to take decisions and act in the best interest of an entity. It is not controlled by a single institution like a government or central bank, but instead divided among a variety of computers, networks, and nodes. It is popular in the cryptocurrency and blockchain community.

title: Decentrawood DAO
content: Decentrawood DAO is the local governing body for the Decentrawood platform, which owns a majority of assets including smart contracts, Meta Land contracts, Avatar clothing, accessories, and Marketplace. It emphasizes 'PEOPLE IN CONTROL' — users who indulge, create, and own the virtual space hold the policies that determine how the metaverse behaves. This includes deciding what items are allowed or disallowed to launch, auction, and more. The community puts forward ideas and votes on upgrades, Meta land auctions, policy updates, whitelisting of NFT contracts, and whatever the community deems appropriate. Voting is governed by Decentrawood DAO's governance interface.

Teams ('Govinda' groups) form human pyramids to break a curd-filled pot (handi) suspended high above the street — a major community event especially in Mumbai and Pune.

It's historically and symbolically significant as the site where India's Prime Minister hoists the national flag and addresses the nation every Independence Day (Aug 15).

title: DAO Proposal System — Categories & Live Activity
content: Decentrawood DAO members can submit proposals under 6 categories via decentrawood.com/dao/submit: (1) Model Build — add/remove a node to the decentralized network of community-run content servers; (2) Point of Interest — highlight a noteworthy Decentrawood location on the map; (3) Name Ban — ban an offensive username; (4) Hiring — request a community member be added/removed from a Committee (e.g., SAB Committee, DAO Committee); (5) Grant Request — request DAO funding for a project/contribution; (6) Poll — create a community poll to gather member opinions. title: Decentrawood Ambassador Program
content: Decentrawood runs an Ambassador Program (decentrawood.com/ambassador) for community members, creators, developers, marketers, gamers, and Web3 enthusiasts. The program selects 30 ambassadors to represent the ecosystem across communities, social platforms, events, and content. Benefits: earn $DEOD based on contribution/activity/consistency/impact, grow Web3 network, get recognition, access ecosystem opportunities, and build a portfolio. Ambassador responsibilities span 6 areas: Community (introduce Decentrawood to relevant Web3 communities), Content (create posts/threads/articles/videos/tutorials), Social Media (drive authentic engagement), Events & Campaigns (support community initiatives), Regional Growth (introduce Decentrawood in specific countries/regions), and Product & Ecosystem (communicate product features/updates to audiences). Process: Apply -> Selection (team reviews and picks 30 based on skills/activity/creativity) -> Onboarding -> Contribute -> Earn $DEOD.
